question: After parallel dispatch, repair halving and shared evidence with a four-claim cap, does a realistic chapter complete on production, and how long does it take?
answer: It completes: 37 claims in 72.5 s with no undecided claim, against 239.8 s and nothing returned on the previous release. Output volume is unchanged; the gain is wall-clock from parallel batches.

environment.session: the same 24-hour guest used for the 2026-09-30 failure record
environment.project: 灰港回声 seed work, Memory V4

issues.claim: 她摸了摸外套内袋，黄铜罗盘还在那里。
issues.assessment: debatable: at 19:50, before the passage, the source has 苏岑 holding it in that pocket; the model weighed the later handoff to 温岚

issues.claim: 就在这时，雾钟响了一次。
issues.assessment: false positive by the earlier record's own definition: chapter 10 already records 北潮闸未关而雾钟响 as an open thread, and the draft itself names the anomaly

issues.claim: 温岚把纸条夹进值守簿。
issues.assessment: reasonable tension: the source has the 值守簿 handed to 苏岑

issues.claim: 航图的缺角被人补上了一块新纸。

longform_run.note: This draft was written for the offline measurement and has no deliberately planted contradictions, so it measures completion and time, not recall.

short_run.draft: 十九点二十，西航道开始涨潮，海水漫上了风栈码头的台阶。苏岑把黄铜罗盘放在外套内袋里。

issues.assessment: the planted contradiction (source: 十九点二十西航道先退潮) was found, as possible_conflict: v22 does not treat an undated shared clock time as the same moment

short_run.note: 35.6k output tokens for two claims is the known thinking-runaway shape on short drafts (dev runs ranged 3-125 s under v22); nothing in this release targets it.

findings: Completion: the long chapter completed with zero undecided claims; the all-or-nothing failure is gone.
Wall-clock: 72.5 s against 239.8 s. Summed model-service time was 231.6 s, so batches ran about 3.2x in parallel.
Tokens: output 46.7k against 51.4k; input rose from 27.5k to 42.6k because the four-claim cap repeats the fixed rules per batch. Input is the cheap side (2 vs 8 CNY per million).
Quality was not measured here. One confirmed_conflict is a known false positive shape (an open thread reported as a rule conflict); that is a judgment question for the held-out set, not this release.
Guest quota: a 37-claim chapter now needs at least 10 dispatches of the 30 a guest gets per 24 hours.
acceptance_draft_text: 十九点五十，苏岑沿着风栈码头往北堤走。潮水已经退到西航道外侧。她摸了摸外套内袋，黄铜罗盘还在那里。镜面的月牙裂纹在路灯下很清楚。温岚在北堤值守簿上记下时间。两人约定今晚不再各自行动。雾线水门外的锚柱上还固定着那张航图。航图右下角缺的那块至今没找到。电台忽然响了，二十一点零五分，三次短促的求救码。温岚把坐标抄在潮表背面。她看得懂坐标，却说不出廊桥钥匙指的是什么。苏岑说那只是一个旧代号。北潮闸那边传来铁链声。闸门还开着一半。就在这时，雾钟响了一次。温岚抬头看向钟楼。按灰港的规矩，闸门没关，雾钟不该响。苏岑没有说话，只把罗盘交到温岚手里。温岚把罗盘放进自己的口袋。她们沿着仓道往水门走去。仓道里堆着去年的渔网。港外传来一声汽笛。那是白色渡船的汽笛。可是最后一班渡船十九点四十就离开了风栈码头。温岚想起那张纸条。纸条上写着白色渡船没有靠岸。署名和日期都被盐雾抹掉了。苏岑说，也许有人故意留下它。温岚把纸条夹进值守簿。她们在水门前停下。水门外的海面一片漆黑。雾越来越浓。苏岑打开手电。光照到锚柱上的航图。航图的缺角被人补上了一块新纸。新纸上画着一条从未见过的航线。温岚握紧了罗盘。
